A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the effects of plough and grazing were more pronounced on life form cover than life form richness.
grazing has a more pronounced effect on old fields than on unploughed renoster veld and that the interaction between grazing and ploughing is more important than either factor in isolation.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the effects of disturbance are more pronounced on old field vegetation than in unploughing vegetation and that the recovery of old fields to unploughed renesterveld takes a minimum of 30 years.
old fields are a valuable resource for the conservation of renostervld species and communities and should be managed as such.
renosterveld old field succession is a complex process with a number of interacting factors influencing the rate of recovery and the final composition.
